answer: A juror that skips cases loses 16% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the pulse decay is applied at each close, the mesa audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the prism fee to keep them eligible. A 278 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
